data.name: About_CommandLineHint
data.value: All commands: Riegel.Cli.exe --help · these details as text: Riegel.Cli.exe --info · Riegel.exe <command> works too, but a console does not wait for it.

data.name: About_CommandLineText
data.value: Riegel.Cli.exe runs the same checks without a window – for scheduled tasks, monitoring (Icinga) and FAT pipelines. Exit codes alert on change, not on standing findings:

data.name: About_Description
data.value: Checks Windows machines in plants, labs and control rooms against a hardening baseline – read-only and offline – records justified exceptions and produces an evidence report for sign-off.

data.name: About_DiagnosticsAnonymous
data.value: Diagnostics package saved: {0} – without names, paths and addresses.

data.name: About_DiagnosticsNamed
data.value: Diagnostics package saved: {0} – with names and paths, pass it on only confidentially.

data.name: About_DiagnosticsText
data.value: Version, system details and the log of the last 7 days as a ZIP for support – never exports, registers or reports.

data.name: About_Exit1
data.value: e.g. exception expiring, measure overdue, outdated or incomplete collection

data.name: About_Exit2
data.value: worse than before or a new open finding of high severity

data.name: About_HelpText
data.value: How to use Riegel, page by page (F1).

data.name: About_KeyboardText
data.value: Ctrl+O open plant · Ctrl+I import · F5 check this PC · Ctrl+E justify as deliberately open · Ctrl+R report · Ctrl+F search · Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+9 pages · F1 documentation · Space marks entries in the registers, Enter edits

data.name: About_LicenseText
data.value: Free use, modification and distribution as long as copyright and licence text are kept.

data.name: About_NoticesText
data.value: Libraries Riegel ships – with version, source, copyright and licence text – and the attributions of the rule sources.

data.name: About_PrivacyText
data.value: Which data Riegel stores where, which connections it opens (none) and how to delete everything.

data.name: About_ReadOnly
data.value: Riegel reads configuration and writes only into the plant folder, the chosen output folder and its data folder. It changes no configuration and opens no network connections.

data.name: About_RuleSourcesHint
data.value: Details on the Rule catalogue page.

data.name: About_SupportText
data.value: Report bugs and ask questions on GitHub – binding with a support contract.

data.name: About_Tagline
data.value: Hardened where it can be. Documented where it can't.
